edition.title: Ex parte Marshall, as printed in Mississippi Reports volume 165

work.author: Mississippi Supreme Court
work.description: A Mississippi contempt decision retrieved as a negative control: a full-text search index reported it as matching phrases from the appointed Epistle, and the case was read entire to establish that those phrases are not in it. Its value to this formulary is the recorded negative, not a use of the Epistle. A locus is a printed page of 165 Miss.
work.title: Ex parte Marshall, 165 Miss. 523, 147 So. 791 (1933)
